title: Macy's Recalls Martha Stewart Whiteware Cake Knife and Server Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The handles on the knife and server can break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 18,900.

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Girona Outdoor Dining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat base can separate from the chair back causing the chair to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: Outlet Converters Recalled by Ningbo Litesun Electric with Home Depot Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The outlet converters front outlet prongs are not configured correctly, resulting in reverse polarity when plugs inserted, posing shock and fire hazards. Units: About 42,000.

title: Toys "R" Us Recalls Infant Wiggle Balls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wiggle ball's rubber knobs and plastic back can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 29,700 (about 3,000 were sold in Canada).

title: SRAM Recalls Bicycle Brakes Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: A rivet in the brake assembly can loosen or disengage, resulting in brake failure, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 7,000.

title: Suunto Recalls Wireless Tank Transmitter and Tank POD Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The exterior plastic case of the Wireless Tank Transmitter and Wireless Tank POD can burst during pre-dive pressure testing, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 35,500 (in addition, about 4,000 in Canada).

title: Playtex Recalls Children's Plates and Bowls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The clear plastic layer over the graphics can peel or bubble from the surface of the plates and bowls, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3.6 million (in addition, about 1.9 million were sold in Canada).

title: Arctic Cat Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Recalled by Textron Specialized Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Heat from the exhaust can melt the plastic panels behind the operator and passenger seat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,100 (In addition, 5,300 were sold in Canada and 100 in Mexico).

title: Diving Unlimited International Recalls Scuba Diving Regulators Due to Drowning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The scuba diving regulators can malfunction, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 480.

title: PlanToys Recalls Baby Gyms Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: Babies can strangle on the side rope crossbars on the baby gyms. Units: About 500.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Infant Motion Seats Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motor housing can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 63,000 (In addition, 2,000 were sold in Canada).

title: BSH Home Appliances Expands Recall of Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The dishwasher power cord can overheat and catch fire. Units: About 408,000 (in addition, about 61,000 were sold in Canada) 149,000 additional units were previously recalled in October 2015. The date range was expanded for previously recalled models..

title: Kids Preferred Recalls Wind-Up Musical Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal post and/or handle of the wind-up mechanism can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 587,000 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Frontier Wood Chippers Recalled by John Deere Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The wood chipper's knives (blades) can break and discharge, hitting the operators or bystanders, posing a risk of injury. Units: 25.

title: Herman Miller Recalls Fiberglass Rocking Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The rocker's base can separate from the seat, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,600 (in addition, about 190 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls ACE 325 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The exhaust header pipe can crack and release hot exhaust gases into the engine compartment, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 6,300.

title: Target Recalls Leather Pouf Ottoman Due to Suffocation and Choking Hazards
summary: The zippers on the pouf ottomans can be opened by children who can then suffocate or choke on the pouf's polystyrene beads. Units: About 7,500.

title: Polaris Recalls General Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The steering wheel shaft can shift and detach while in use, resulting in a loss of control and crash hazard. Units: About 19,000.
